hypothesis: An announcement-based angle, read at its registered default grid point, ranks the codes of the day in the same order as their market-adjusted 20-session outcome on sessions it has not been fitted on. The 22 angles are one family. A pass would allow only a look and a result on file; no status changes (a status change goes through the Owner-run passport import).
market_rule: each market is counted and tested on its own archive; a lineage and its plan are per market
counter: the number of distinct session dates with at least one archived announcement carrying a timing class (pre_open, intraday, post_close), counted from the dates alone before any outcome is read
below_floor: INCONCLUSIVE: no look is taken, no outcome is read, the plan stays frozen and the one look waits for the night the counter reaches the floor
set_rule: the angles whose registry entry names the announcement archive as missing data and reads announcements as an input; the spec's count of 24 is recorded as a mismatch
development: the first 70 % of the sessions (the integer part of 0.7 times the count), used only to fix each angle's sign at its registered default grid point; a development mean of exactly zero, or no defined day, leaves the angle INCONCLUSIVE
holdout: the remaining last sessions; one look per lineage and market, never repeated
outcome: return from the open after the signal session to the open 20 sessions later, minus the median of the same return over the tier U1 codes of that session
daily_statistic: Spearman rank correlation of the angle value and the outcome across the codes of the session, at least 10 codes with both defined, else the day is left out
statistic: the sign fixed in development times the mean of the daily rank correlations over the holdout sessions
interval: stationary block bootstrap of the daily series, expected block 20 sessions, 2000 replicates, one-sided
p_value: (1 + the number of replicate means at or below zero) / (replicates + 1)
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the angles that reached a statistic, q = 0.10, positive dependence
pass_rule: an angle is PASS when the procedure rejects it and its holdout mean is above zero; NULL when it is not rejected; INCONCLUSIVE when a statistic cannot be computed
labels: the three text labels (guidance, event_confirm, tone) are evaluated the same way as one family only if labelled holdout announcements are at least 70 % of the holdout announcements, else INCONCLUSIVE without a look
consequence: a PASS writes the look and the result only; any status change goes through the Owner-run passport import
